title: Specification must be made in Form 2
requirement: Every specification, whether provisional or complete, shall be made in Form 2.
compliance_check: Verify that the uploaded specification is intended to correspond to Form 2.
recommendation: Confirm that the document is being prepared/filed as the applicable Form 2 specification.

title: Description and title of invention
requirement: Every specification shall describe the invention and shall begin with a title sufficiently indicating the subject matter to which the invention relates.
compliance_check: Check whether the document contains a clear title and whether the specification describes the invention.
recommendation: Ensure that the title clearly identifies the subject matter and that the specification describes the invention.

title: Full and particular description
requirement: A complete specification shall fully and particularly describe the invention and its operation or use and the method by which it is to be performed.
compliance_check: Assess whether the specification adequately describes the invention, operation/use and method of performing it.
recommendation: Review the detailed description and ensure that the disclosed invention and its operation or method of performance are adequately described.

title: Best method
requirement: A complete specification shall disclose the best method of performing the invention known to the applicant for which the applicant is entitled to claim protection.
compliance_check: Assess whether the specification appears to disclose the best method known to the applicant.
recommendation: Review the embodiments and implementation details to determine whether the best known method is adequately disclosed.

title: Claims defining scope
requirement: A complete specification shall end with a claim or claims defining the scope of the invention for which protection is claimed.
compliance_check: Detect the claims section and verify that one or more claims are present.
recommendation: Ensure that the complete specification contains claims defining the scope of protection sought.

title: Abstract
requirement: A complete specification shall be accompanied by an abstract to provide technical information on the invention.
compliance_check: Detect whether an abstract is present.
recommendation: Ensure that the complete specification is accompanied by an abstract providing technical information about the invention.

title: Single invention or linked group
requirement: Claims shall relate to a single invention, or to a group of inventions linked so as to form a single inventive concept.
compliance_check: Analyze independent claims and determine whether they appear technically related to a single inventive concept.
recommendation: Review claim groups for technical unity and ensure that apparently separate inventions are appropriately linked where applicable.

title: Claim clarity and succinctness
requirement: Claims shall be clear and succinct.
compliance_check: Analyze claims for ambiguity, unclear terminology, unnecessarily complex construction and unclear relationships.
recommendation: Review unclear terminology, ambiguous relationships and unnecessarily complicated claim language.

title: Fair basis of claims
requirement: Claims shall be fairly based on the matter disclosed in the specification.
compliance_check: Compare each significant claim limitation with the description and identify limitations for which clear support is not found.
recommendation: Review claim limitations that do not have clear support in the specification.

title: Drawings and reference signs
requirement: Where the invention requires explanation through drawings, drawings shall comply with Rule 15 and shall be supplied with and referred to in detail in the specification; features illustrated in drawings shall be followed by their respective reference signs in parentheses where applicable.
compliance_check: Where drawings are present or necessary, compare drawing numbers, reference signs and references in the description and claims.
recommendation: Check consistency of figures, reference signs and corresponding descriptions.

title: Irrelevant matter
requirement: Irrelevant or other matter not necessary, in the opinion of the Controller, for elucidation of the invention shall be excluded from the title, description, claims and drawings.
compliance_check: Identify content that appears unrelated or unnecessary for explaining the invention.
recommendation: Consider removing irrelevant or unnecessary material while preserving required disclosure.

title: Abstract begins with title
requirement: The abstract accompanying the specification shall commence with the title of the invention.
compliance_check: Compare the beginning of the abstract with the title of the invention.
recommendation: Ensure that the abstract commences with the title of the invention.

title: Title normally not more than fifteen words
requirement: The title of the invention shall disclose the specific features of the invention normally in not more than fifteen words.
compliance_check: Count title words and assess whether the title exceeds fifteen words.
recommendation: Consider shortening the title where it exceeds fifteen words while retaining the specific features of the invention.

title: Abstract technical content
requirement: The abstract shall contain a concise summary of the matter contained in the specification and indicate clearly the technical field, technical advancement compared with existing knowledge and principal use, excluding speculative use.
compliance_check: Analyze the abstract for technical field, technical advancement, principal use and consistency with the specification.
recommendation: Revise the abstract to provide a concise and technically accurate summary supported by the specification.

title: Abstract word limit
requirement: The abstract may not contain more than one hundred and fifty words.
compliance_check: Count the words in the abstract and flag an abstract exceeding 150 words.
recommendation: Reduce the abstract to not more than 150 words.

title: Abstract drawing references
requirement: If the specification contains drawings, the applicant shall indicate on the abstract the figure or exceptionally figures that may accompany the abstract when published; main features mentioned in the abstract and illustrated by a drawing shall be followed by the reference sign used in that drawing.
compliance_check: When drawings exist, compare abstract figure references and reference signs against the drawings and specification.
recommendation: Ensure that the abstract identifies the appropriate figure(s) and uses corresponding reference signs for illustrated features.

title: Abstract as search instrument
requirement: The abstract shall be drafted so that it constitutes an efficient instrument for searching in the particular technical field.
compliance_check: Assess whether the abstract provides meaningful technical information useful for identifying the invention.
recommendation: Ensure that the abstract uses accurate technical terminology and efficiently communicates the invention.

title: Declaration as to inventorship
requirement: In prescribed cases, a declaration as to inventorship shall be filed in Form 5 with the complete specification or within the prescribed period.
compliance_check: Determine whether the filing circumstances indicate that a Form 5 inventorship declaration is required.
recommendation: Review whether Form 5 and the prescribed timing requirements apply to the particular application.
